The '''2013–14 Danish Superliga''' season was the 24th season of the [[Danish Superliga]], which decided the [[Danish football championship]].

== Teams ==
[[AC Horsens]] and [[Silkeborg IF]] finished the [[2012–13 Danish Superliga|2012–13 season]] in 11th and 12th place, respectively, and were relegated to the [[2013–14 Danish 1st Division|2013–14 1st Division]].

The relegated teams were replaced by [[2012–13 Danish 1st Division|2012–13 1st Division]] champions [[Viborg FF]] and the runners-up [[FC Vestsjælland]].
